levels.surface: عبد العزيز بن عبد الملك بن أبي محذورة

notes: «قلت لأبي محذورة ... فأخبرني أن أبا محذورة قال» : Ibn Muhayriz asks and Abu Mahdhura answers, then Abu Mahdhura speaks: one link (rules 5 and 7)
«وكان يتيما في حجر أبي محذورة» is Muslim's biographical gloss, not a link
the second group comes after the saying and carries it, so it is a route; the text gives no source for the unnamed informant, so the order of its two levels is the text's reading only
